channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Sam Cassell | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Sam Cassell from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Cuttino Mobley on Corey Maggette, Elton Brand, Shaun Livingston, Sam Cassell
item.description:
Cuttino Mobley:

“There were times, man, where I'd score like 15 first quarter, 12 first quarter, and then I’d feel that—and I have to give the ball up. You know what I’m saying? Like, I always wanted to be part of the group, never lead the group—until I started getting older. Then I was fine with leading, but letting everybody else shine. That was my role with the Clippers—with Elton Brand, Corey Maggette, Shaun Livingston, and Sam Cassell.”

Cuttino Mobley on Corey Maggette, Elton Brand, Shaun Livingston, Sam Cassell, Oct 5, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Sam Cassell, Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
“I’m going to add to what I got right now. I’ve got to add to it. It’s already good! I’ve got to add to it. It’s already there. So,I’m bringing Mazzulla back but maybe I’m bringing in a veteran coach, like Sam Cassell. Some influence on the bench. Respect. A champion. Been a coach. Understands what it takes.”

Paul Pierce on Sam Cassell, Joe Mazzulla, Jun 3, 2023. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Sam Cassell, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Doc Rivers:

“He works with Sam Cassell and my son Spencer, they're skill-developing coaches. He called Spencer two weeks ago because, I guess like Ros, he went on vacation. The difference, Ros, is this is the first vacation he'd ever been on in his entire life. That's what he was telling us. I was like, 'Wait, what?' He was like, 'No, I've never been on vacation. He asked Spencer, 'What do you do on vacation?' True question, what do you do on vacation? And Spence was like, 'You relax!' And [Tyrese goes], 'For how long? For how many days? We're going for a week, I can't relax for a week.'”

Doc Rivers on Sam Cassell, Tyrese Maxey, Aug 4, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Patrick Ewing on Sam Cassell
item.description:
Ewing on the 1994 Finals:

“We had an opportunity to beat Houston, and I’m not gonna say it was the game where John (Starks) missed those shots. I think that the third game — our first game back at home — Sam Cassell hit a huge 3 to propel them to the victory, but we were right there to get that game, and if we had gotten that game I thought that the series would not have gone back to Houston and we would have won. But it is what it is. Take our hat off to Hakeem [Olajuwon] and those guys, they did a great job.”

Patrick Ewing on Sam Cassell, May 6, 2021. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Mark Jackson, Tyronn Lue, Sam Cassell
item.description:
“He has good players there — matter of fact, he has two great players there. He has a great foundation to start off of, and I look forward to seeing Brooklyn being one of the better teams next year. And Steve’s influence is gonna be a lot of that success, and I look for him to do big things there. Butif I was to be candid, you’ve got Mark Jackson out there. You’ve got Sam Cassell out there. You’ve got Tyronn Lue out there. You know what I’m saying? Proven guys, but Steve’s my guy. I’ll support him in anything he does,but it was also some — in my estimation — some deeper candidates out there that Brooklyn could have went with.”

Kevin Garnett on Mark Jackson, Tyronn Lue, Sam Cassell, Sep 10, 2020. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Eddie House, Stephon Marbury, Sam Cassell, Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Bob Garcia:Rajon Rondo on if he's going to mentor Lonzo Ball:

“Yeah that's obviously. My rookie year my guys were Sam Cassell, Stephon Marbury, and Eddie House. I didn't look at this guys as competition.”

Rajon Rondo on Eddie House, Stephon Marbury, Sam Cassell, Lonzo Ball, Sep 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @bgarciaivsports.

item.title: Caron Butler on Sam Cassell
item.description:
Michael Lee:Caron Butler on Sam Cassell dance fine:

“It kind of makes you robotic. You don’t want to be disrespectful. If I was, I’m sorry.”

Caron Butler on Sam Cassell, Dec 6, 2013. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.
